description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller for administration of system configurations within a web application. It includes request mappings for displaying and saving system configuration settings, interacts with service layer components, and manages UI menu data.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller class handling HTTP requests related to system configuration administration, including displaying and saving configuration settings.

methods.name: displaySysyemConfgurations
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current system configurations. Retrieves configuration data and prepares the view.

methods.name: saveSystemConfigurations
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated system configurations. Saves data via service and updates the view.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set up menu-related model attributes for the view rendering.
